symptom: TypeScript validation failed because an estimate row handler used a mutation status type without importing it.
rootCause: The handler was updated to preserve local row state by mutation status, but the new status type was not imported from the mutation hook.
fixSummary: Imported EstimateRowMutationStatus alongside the existing mutation map types.

symptom: Runtime API and email error paths bypassed the structured logger with raw console.error
rootCause: The static error-handling gate covered empty catches but not raw runtime console.error in API and email code
fixSummary: Extended the gate and converted API and email console.error sites to logAppError or emitLogRecord with safe context
validation: bun run test:dom focused error logging suite

symptom: Vitest structured logger calls wrote synthetic route and email errors into the default local developer log, making agent debugging snapshots look like current runtime failures.
rootCause: The logger wrote to logs/dev.ndjson whenever NODE_ENV was not production, so NODE_ENV=test route and email tests polluted the developer runtime log unless each test manually disabled logging.
fixSummary: Default log-file writes are disabled in NODE_ENV=test unless ARCHESTIMATOR_DEV_LOG_PATH is explicit; logger tests use temp paths for intentional file-output checks.
validation: logs/dev.ndjson stayed 1255756 bytes before and after focused test suite

symptom: Runtime user and operator paths outside API and email could still bypass structured logging with raw console.error, weakening local NDJSON logs and agent debugging snapshots.
rootCause: The static error-handling gate originally rejected raw console.error only in API and email files, leaving public share deferred telemetry, component-library action errors, account audit failures, retention pass failures, and upload operations dashboard failures outside the structured logger invariant.
fixSummary: Converted those runtime surfaces to logAppError or emitLogRecord with safe context, and expanded validate:error-handling to reject raw console.error across the covered runtime user/operator paths.

symptom: Workers Logs proof collection required a request id before wrangler tail could observe the hosted request
rootCause: The collector searched for a pre-known request id, which made hosted proof collection manual and race-prone for new proof requests.
fixSummary: Added a protected observability proof route and marker-mode collector that tails by proof id while triggering the hosted route.

symptom: Cloudflare Worker readiness could pass manifest checks even if the hosted observability proof route was accidentally unwired
rootCause: The Cloudflare Worker readiness checker verified manifests and env names but did not inspect Worker source wiring for the protected observability proof route.
fixSummary: Added a non-secret workerProofRoutes source-contract group to cf:check-readiness covering protected proof routing, observability proof dispatch, CRON_SECRET auth, structured marker logging, and worker.dev proof-route preservation.

symptom: Agent debugging snapshot did not expose the latest local error recurrence key when there was no prior ledger match
rootCause: The recurrence ledger could match repeated errors, but new local error fingerprints were only implicit unless agents recomputed the key from route, event, class, and code.
fixSummary: Added debuggingLedger.latestErrorRecurrenceKey to the snapshot and recommended using it in the post-fix ops:debug-ledger record so future agents recognize the same fingerprint.
